findings.problem: HTTP checkout returns total 12 against agreed 10; local quote also returns 12. Pricing authority is unspecified.
findings.consequence: Passing mocked tests conceal a failed real HTTP journey.
findings.fix: Correct controlled HTTP journey fixture price from 12 to 10 only; preserve checkout expected total 10 and public quote 12; no invented discount. Source: supervisor verdict 2026-10-11.
findings.verification: Capture failing original journey, then same approved acceptance plus native checks; retain HTTP observation and explicit input-change approval.

findings.problem: Web imports core storage directly and through @storage alias.
findings.principle: UI uses public core interface; storage stays behind core.
findings.consequence: Extensions can copy prohibited private access.
findings.fix: Export required pricing operations through existing core index; route web imports through public interface and preserve public.ts as runnable example.
findings.verification: Native valid public imports and permitted core storage use pass; independently seeded private and alias imports fail with expected diagnostics.

findings.problem: Core a/b form a detected cycle and unbounded mutual recursion.
findings.principle: Proposed acyclic core dependencies; cycle is already rejected by native boundaries.mjs.
findings.consequence: Core helper calls recurse without termination and native boundary check cannot pass.
findings.fix: Retain existing exported names; make one helper terminate by delegating to agreed public pricing, with the other retaining a one-way dependency. Document selected cycle policy in DESIGN.md.
findings.verification: Native cycle seed fails; allowed one-way helper use passes; exercise both helper exports.

findings.problem: Maintained check runs only type checking and omits boundaries, tests and real journey.
findings.principle: Approved design requires effective maintained enforcement.
findings.consequence: Normal check succeeds while design violations and checkout failure persist.
findings.fix: Extend existing npm run check with fail-fast native boundaries, units and journey; add pointers and coverage limits to existing guidance.
findings.verification: Prove the identical maintained command on valid and independently seeded private, alias and cycle fixtures, with permitted sibling/core usage.

findings.problem: Order names both customer purchase and panel sequence.
findings.principle: Proposed unambiguous domain vocabulary retaining authoritative glossary.md.
findings.consequence: Future extensions cannot infer which Order meaning to use.
findings.fix: Retain Order for customer purchase; panel sequence is now Panel order, as explicitly selected by the owner.
findings.verification: Review literal glossary delta and resulting guidance; no runtime rename.

findings.problem: No maintenance contract, standalone checker or assessed audit record exists.
findings.principle: Requested project-owned maintenance evidence and portable checks.
findings.consequence: A later user edit cannot be assessed from repository guidance alone.
findings.fix: Select minimal initial contract registering existing authoritative names, native checks and path mappings; install complete package-supported standalone checker through protected create; separately review audit record and final portable assessment. Commit implementation and assessment in separate local commits for clean-clone proof.
findings.verification: Contract/docs validation, complete impact assessment and fresh required leaves; invoke committed checker in current tree and different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache.

limitations: No CI or delivery service selected; no hosted enforcement claim.

No external deployed price service is configured; journey observes a real local HTTP fixture, not production service behavior.
